rationale: The agent located the user and relevant order and executed an exchange; however, it submitted the exchange without first confirming the order-changing action with the user, which violates the stated policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. While it appears to have acted on the correct user/order and provided final details (refund amount, payment method), the absence of explicit pre-action confirmation is a clear policy breach. Therefore, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
